question: For Regional Championship Gdańsk, report observed unique played pairings and player-result records.

source.description: Data provider: limitless_play, limitless_labs, or unknown.

event_type.description: Event setting: online, in_person, or unknown. Independent of data provider.

set_name.description: The set or meta period assigned to the tournament.

player_count.description: Number of players in the tournament.

total_matches.description: Deprecated alias for perspective_record_count; counts player records, including byes and unresolved records, not unique matches.

perspective_record_count.description: Number of staged player-result records, including byes and unresolved records.

unique_match_count.description: Observed unique played pairings with known players and rounds; excludes byes and unresolved pairings. Not a completeness guarantee.

mirrored_match_count.description: Unique played pairings with histories for both players.

one_sided_match_count.description: Unique played pairings with history for only one of the two known players.

bye_record_count.description: Player records explicitly marked BYE; excluded from unique played matches.

unresolved_perspective_record_count.description: Player records without a reliable played-match identity; inspect tournament_matches.resolution_reason.

duplicate_perspective_record_count.description: Extra records for the same player within a reconciled group, including normalized-round duplicates.

conflicting_outcome_match_count.description: Identified played pairings with contradictory outcomes. Included in unique_match_count; original outcomes are preserved.

incomplete_outcome_match_count.description: Identified played pairings with at least one missing or unrecognized outcome. Included in unique_match_count.

answer.explanation: For Gdańsk the tournament model reports 7,112 observed played pairings and 14,239 player-result records. The latter includes 15 bye records; twice 7,112 plus 15 equals 14,239. These are imported observations, not a guarantee of complete source coverage.
